'''Lenk''' was a [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|female]] who was a member of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] early in the [[Imperial Era]]. She participated in a mission to [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Ryloth)|rescue]] several rebels arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]] after being caught smuggling weapons. However, most of the freedom fighters, including Lenk, were captured in an Imperial ambush.<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> However, she and the other freedom fighters were rescued from Imperial custody by [[Clone Force 99]].<ref name="Rescue">{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}
